desc: Ryan and another man are playing foosball at the office.
Dwight answers the phone at his desk, then reacts in shock, raises his eyebrows, eyes wide and mouth open.
Dwight slowly approaches a door, stands in the doorway, and touches the frame of the door with both hands.
Dwight sits at his desk, seen through blinds, mouth wide open in shock, both hands resting on the desk.
Dwight talks on the phone, seen through blinds, then suddenly smirks slyly, pulling it from his ear and flinching upward.
Jim is sitting in the car, rolling the window down to talk to Pam outside.
Angela is checking a punch card that's stuck at the time clock on the wall.
Jim sticks his pencil into the time clock on the wall, which snaps it.
Jim tries to fit an oversized business card into his wallet.
A wide shot of Dwight, hand on chest, facing an American flag near Erin at the reception desk, his portrait on the wall.
Dwight jumps out, scaring Kelly as she enters her cubicle in the office.
Dwight, standing in front of Kelly, crouches down and points his finger from her feet up to her stomach.
The tall man in a suit exits the office room before Andy, fake-smiling widely while crying.
Jim pins a poster with a drawing of a fist to the bulletin board in the office hallway.
Dwight rips the fist poster off the board and tosses it into the trash bin by the bathroom.
Jim walks in and pins two fist posters side by side on the bulletin board in the office hallway.
Kevin inserts a card's numbers into a machine, with an impatient Angela and Darryl waiting behind him.
Stanley is pouring himself coffee from a pitcher, under the watch of a camera above him in the office kitchen.
A shot of excited Dwight sitting at a desk, surrounded by samurai armor, a sword, and a display case with a revolver.
A shot of Dwight opening a box with a small sword.
Dwight drops the sword he used to open the box, shocked and moved, sits down pulling something from the box.
Dwight, standing tall, proudly walks up to Jim's desk with a revolver in a leather holster on his belt.
A straight-backed Dwight stretches in the office around people, with a revolver in a leather holster on his belt.
A close-up shot of Dwight's belt with a revolver and phone holster.
Dwight plays with the gun in front of people, and it fires, startling everyone.
Andy clutches his ear after the gunshot right in front of him.
Oscar sits on the carpet floor, touching a hole in it with a concerned face.
Dwight is giving away a gun to Creed.
Andy gets up from his chair, holding on to Darryl, and walks away with him, limping.
Dwight hops into the office wearing a cowboy hat, pretending to shoot with his fingers and lasso something.
Dwight walks out of the bathroom holding a large glass aquarium.
Kevin walks into the bathroom and immediately runs out, terrified, pulling up his pants.
A gray-haired woman walks into the office with two dogs on a leash.
Dwight presses on Kevin's back as he sits at his desk, bracing both feet hard against a cabinet behind the desk.
Oscar photographs Dwight pressing on Kevin's back, feet braced against a cabinet.
Creed sets his things out on the counter in the office room and sits in the leather armchair, satisfied.
